issue.title: check fails with "differs from the template" after Dependabot moved the pin
issue.body:
### What happened?

Dependabot moved the pin of the issue assistant in our workflows from v1.1.0 to v1.2.2, and we merged it. Since then the step of our CI that runs `check` fails, although nobody changed the workflows by hand. I expected the new pin to be all that a new release needs.

### Area

Install, check, templates or labels

### Release of the issue assistant

v1.2.2

### Link to the workflow run

_No response_

### Log lines

```text
::error::.github/workflows/issue-assistant.yml differs from the template of the issue assistant; only the refs of its actions may differ
::error::.github/workflows/issue-lifecycle.yml differs from the template of the issue assistant; only the refs of its actions may differ
```

### Checklist

- [X] I searched the existing issues and did not find this problem.
- [X] I removed tokens, keys and personal data from everything I posted.

comments.body: labels.yml and findings.yml still pass the check; only the two workflows above fail.
